titleEn: I Want to Build It Myself

pages.text: Lots of wooden blocks lay scattered across the classroom floor. Mio stood them up one by one.
Mio wanted to build a tower taller than Mio was. "I want to build it all by myself."
Duri offered a block. Mio shook their head.
The tower reached Mio's belly. Mio stretched up onto tiptoe.
The tower reached Mio's nose. Mio's hands were trembling.
Mio put one more block on top. The tower tilted.
Crash! All the blocks scattered across the floor. Mio plopped down right there.
Teacher Bau sat beside Mio. "Mio, will two hands be enough?"
Mio held a block out to Duri. "Let's build it together."
Duri held the bottom steady while Mio added blocks on top. The tower rose far above Mio's head. They stood side by side and looked up at the top.
